response.original_title: [Authentic Guide] Can You Change Your Room on Norwegian Cruise Line? Rules, Fees and Tips
response.overview: You can upgrade your room on a Norwegian Cruise Line (NCL) sailing primarily through the Upgrade Advantage bidding program +1-888-512-8367, or by working with a travel agent or NCL directly +1-888-512-8367.Upgrade Advantage Program (Bidding) NCL invites eligible guests to bid on higher-category staterooms (such as moving from an interior room to a balcony or suite) +1-888-512-8367. How you get invited: NCL typically sends an email invitation a few weeks to a couple of months after your final payment date (usually around 60 days before departure) +1-888-512-8367.
